<!-- pr-reviewer: 197420e88ece287f0aac9261b1be769702c92476 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good
- The root cause is fixed in the product code, not only in the test. `link_owner::owner` unlocks right after it proves the lock is free (crates/app/src/mcp/link_owner.rs); `Registration::drop` unlocks after it removes the files (crates/app/src/mcp/link.rs); `link::open` also unlocks on the bind-error path.
- The failure direction is safe everywhere: an unlock that fails leaves the entry unproved, and a file that cannot be proved is never dialed (the CLI still skips it). No retry, no sleep, no `#[ignore]`.
- The residual case (a window crashing while one of its threads is starting a child) is named in the decision record (docs/decisions/4041-ui-link-lock-release.md), with the reason a retry or a sleep would hide the defect instead of closing it.
- The PR is small, focused, clean-room: no HSMWorks material, provenance lines intact, no snapshot PNG changes, no process files touched, no new dependencies, no new top-level test file.

## Results
- Trial merge with `origin/main` (267ee5096): clean - main is an ancestor of the head, no conflict.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run --lib --test mcp_live` (app build): ok, 4m23s.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live ui_link_owner`: 3 passed (the two pinned by the 200-run loop, plus the no-owner-proof test).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live` (full binary, 25 tests): 25 passed, 0 failed. The red test `ui_link_owner::a_false_server_that_proves_the_token_gets_no_tool_call_when_the_window_has_ended` no longer appears.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light --base origin/main`): 6 steps, all ok (wall 5.6 min, 0 failed, 0 stalled).

Where: locally, in the review worktree (Linux), CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6.

## Targeted tests
- No post or toolpath change: no example-catalog suites owed. This is a P2 PR (#4041): no heavy step owed.
- Light lane result: 6 steps, all ok (wall 5.6 min, 0 failed, 0 stalled).

## Requested before merge
- Nothing blocking.

## Questions / notes
- `Changelog: none` - the fix changes a user-visible path (`camcraft-cli --ui` no longer dials a window that has ended and no longer sends a tool call to a false server). A one-line row for this defect might be worth adding at the next cut; not blocking.
- The PR body quotes a 42/150 failure count for the unchanged binary and the decision record quotes 44/150. The two figures are consistent: 42 failures in the false-server test and 2 in the crashed-window test, 44 failures in total. No action needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
